verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee provides premium proxies to bypass hard-to-scrape sites and JS 'scenario' scripting to interact with pages (e.g., click/fill forms), which could support login flows, but there is no explicit claim or evidence of automatic CAPTCHA solving or a documented login-automation workflow that removes manual intervention entirely. missing for 10: explicit CAPTCHA-solving mechanism, documented login/form-wall bypass workflow, and independent evidence of successful autonomous bypass.
